akl_001: You can recognise it by its three trunks and curtain of aerial roots, spread twice as wide as it is tall. It stands in Windsor Reserve, beside the Devonport Library.
akl_002: You can recognise it as the elder of the two oaks on the school's street frontage, beside the War Memorial Gates. It stands on the Anzac Street side of Takapuna Primary School.
akl_003: You can recognise it as the younger of the two oaks on the school's street frontage, a few metres from its sibling. It stands on the Anzac Street side of Takapuna Primary School, beside the War Memorial Gates.
akl_004: You can recognise it by its three merged trunks and enormous crown, spreading over 50 metres wide. It stands in Monte Cecilia Park, near the old carriageway to the Pah Homestead.
akl_005: You can recognise it by the fence around its root zone and its canopy trailing down to the ground in a skirt of branches. It stands on the lawn west of Pohutukawa Drive in Cornwall Park, near Twin Oak Drive.
